name: Websites - Authorized - Document Converter Domains [is]
description: Intent: Authorized document-converter domains — populate with sanctioned online format converters your users are licensed to use (e.g., cloudconvert.com, smallpdf.com, ilovepdf.com, zamzar.com). Drives the Authorized split on M1040 and is negated in M1041 / W1041 / B1040 to define the unauthorized converter surface. Lower priority — only meaningful if your org prohibits or scrutinizes external document conversion. Exclusions: do not add free or unknown converters lacking encryption/deletion guarantees; do not add services with poor privacy policies.
